fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: A display name for the pool.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: The mode for the pool is operating in.

fields.label: Workload Identity Pool ID
fields.help: The ID to use for the pool, which becomes the final component of the resource name.

fields.label: Attestation Rules
Google Cloud Resource
fields.help: A single workload operating on Google Cloud.
Defines which workloads can receive an identity within a pool.

fields.label: Inline Certificate Issuance Config
Key Algorithm
fields.help: Key algorithm to use when generating the key pair.

fields.label: Lifetime
fields.help: Lifetime of the workload certificates issued by the CA pool in seconds.

fields.label: Rotation Window Percentage
fields.help: Rotation window percentage indicating when certificate rotation should be initiated based on remaining lifetime.

fields.label: Use Default Shared Ca
fields.help: If set to true, the trust domain will utilize the GCP-provisioned default CA.
Represents configuration for generating mutual TLS (mTLS) certificates for the identities within this pool.

fields.label: Inline Trust Config
Additional Trust Bundles
Trust Default Shared Ca
fields.help: If set to True, the trust bundle will include the private ca managed identity regional root public certificates.

fields.label: Trust Anchors
Pem Certificate
fields.help: PEM certificate of the PKI used for validation.
List of Trust Anchors to be used while performing validation against a given 'TrustStore'.
Maps specific trust domains (e.g., "example.com") to their corresponding 'TrustStore' objects, which contain the trusted root certificates for that domain.
Represents config to add additional trusted trust domains.
